description: Predbežné hodnotenia povodňových rizík 2025 is a dataset listed in INSPIRE Discovery Service Slovakia, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by reportnet.europa.eu. Spatial data set providing information on the assessment of potential flood risk as required Directive 2007/60/EC of the European Parliament and of the Council on the assessment and management of flood risks for the 2025 reporting period. Coverage: SK. The portal shows the English title as "Preliminary Flood Risk Assessments 2025" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMS, WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.sk). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-csw-sk.
